character_1_text.eng: I want the best future for my children, but I don’t know where to get the money. Loan sharks are dangerous and paying them back is so expensive. I should save, but that feels impossible!

rows.character_1_text: I want the best future for my children, but I don’t know where to get the money. Loan sharks are dangerous and paying them back is so expensive. I should save, but that feels impossible!
My goal is to make sure my children reach their dream of university. How can I save a lot of money with the little money I have?

character_1_text.eng: My goal is to make sure my children reach their dream of university. How can I save a lot of money with the little money I have?

rows.character_1_text: Hmm, maybe I can start with a plan. First, let me make a budget – a plan for how I can save my money. Then I will save just a little bit of money at a time – I will even join a savings and loans group.

rows.text_1_facilitator: 5️⃣ Here are five tips on how to make a savings plan for you and your child:

text_1_facilitator.eng: 5️⃣ Here are five tips on how to make a savings plan for you and your child:

section_1_text.eng:
Decide why you want to save money. These could include:
😔 Preparing for emergencies
🎁 Buying something nice for you or your child or do something fun as a family
📖 Planning for future big expenses like improvements on your home or for your child’s education

section_2_text.eng:
🚩 Set a target amount that you want to save. 
💰 Look at your monthly budget and decide how much you can save each week and each month.

section_3_text.eng:
Consider the different ways to keep money safe for future use. These could include:
🔑 Saving at a bank
💚 Keeping money safe at home
💰 Keeping money in a savings and loan group
🌷 Buying livestock like goats or cattle 
Decide which way of saving money would work best for the family.

section_4_text.eng: ❗ If you can try and save even a tiny amount for the future or for an emergency. This can make a big difference over time.

section_5_text.eng:
🌱 Your government or community groups may be giving money, vouchers, or food parcels to families in need. 
💛 Think about whether there are places in your community that provide support.
